item.title: Screen all kids between 2 and 10 for high cholesterol, pediatric society recommends
item.description: TORONTO — The Canadian Paediatric Society is recommending cholesterol screening for all kids between two and 10 years old.

item.title: UK Green Party wins special election, pushing Starmer's Labour to third place
item.description: LONDON (AP) — The Green Party won a special parliamentary election in England on Friday, a big boost for the small party and a blow to Prime Minister Keir Starmer , whose center-left Labour Party was relegated to third place.

item.title: Jean-Gabriel Pageau helps Islanders complete overtime rally against Canadiens
item.description: MONTREAL — Jean-Gabriel Pageau scored 1:46 into overtime as the New York Islanders rallied past the Montreal Canadiens 4-3 on Thursday at Bell Centre.

item.title: Nazem Kadri scores 2 goals to lead the Flames to a 4-1 win over the Sharks
item.description: SAN JOSE, Calif. (AP) — Nazem Kadri scored two goals and the Calgary Flames beat the San Jose Sharks 4-1 on Thursday night in the first game back from the Olympic break for both teams.

item.title: US military used laser to take down Border Protection drone, lawmakers say
item.description: The U.S. military used a laser Thursday to shoot down a “seemingly threatening” drone flying near the U.S.-Mexico border. It turned out the drone belonged to Customs and Border Protection, lawmakers said.
